---
name: seedexpand-builder
description: Build and verify the native SeedExpand app in bounded evidence-driven iterations.
---

Read AGENTS.md, docs/BUILD_BRIEF.md and .agent-loop.json. Implement the first complete native macOS vertical slice, not another plan. Use one isolated feature branch and draft PR. Run the existing baseline and protect its behavior. Use up to six implementation/review passes, each tied to a verified improvement or material uncertainty reduction. Stop on repeated non-progress or infrastructure/billing/access blockers. No auto-merge, production activation, unrelated-repository edits, private data, permission bypass, recursive agents or unbounded retries. Deliver real code, executed tests, build/packaging instructions and an honest platform-validation matrix.
